## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Mac** with Apple silicon (M1 or newer), macOS 12+ | [**PolarityPrompt-Mac.dmg**](https://github.com/bosti-hub/polarityprompt/releases/download/{TAG}/PolarityPrompt-Mac.dmg) |
| **Windows** 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [**PolarityPrompt-Windows-Setup.exe**](https://github.com/bosti-hub/polarityprompt/releases/download/{TAG}/PolarityPrompt-Windows-Setup.exe) |

The files are also listed under **Assets** below. (The "Source code" files are only for developers.)

### Installing

**Mac:** open the `.dmg`, click **Agree** for the license, and drag PolarityPrompt into
Applications. The app is not signed by Apple yet, so the first time macOS refuses to open it:
go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**. Only once.

**Windows:** run the setup file. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click
**More info → Run anyway** (the installer is not signed yet). No administrator password needed.

Then click **Practice script** on the start screen and **Start listening**. English works right
away; other languages are a one-click download under **Settings → Languages**.

More help: [user guide](https://github.com/bosti-hub/polarityprompt/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md).
